# Task Packet — Issue NUMBER: Short title

> Copy to `docs/work/active/issue-NUMBER-short-slug.md`. Replace placeholders and delete instructional text.

## Identity

- Issue: NUMBER
- Owner: USER
- Status: in-progress
- Branch: `issue/NUMBER-short-slug`
- Worktree: PATH
- Base branch/SHA: BASE
- Head SHA: HEAD
- Last handoff: DATE

## Goal

One paragraph. Link to the issue instead of copying its full body.

## Read first

Keep this to the smallest useful set—normally one domain page, one contract/ADR, and selected code entry points.

1. DOMAIN PAGE
2. CONTRACT OR ADR
3. CODE ENTRY POINT

## Dependencies and blockers

- Depends on: ISSUE OR NONE
- Blocks: ISSUE OR NONE
- Current blocker: NONE

## Scope and non-goals

### In scope

- ITEM

### Out of scope

- ITEM

## Ownership and touch set

Expected paths:

- `path/`

Shared contracts/schemas touched: NONE

Potential parallel conflicts: NONE

## Plan

- [ ] STEP

## Progress and decisions

- DATE — FACT OR DECISION

Record contradictions and link durable decisions to an ADR. Do not paste transcripts.

## Verification

- [ ] `COMMAND`

## Handoff

- Completed:
- Remaining:
- Known failures/risks:
- Next smallest action:
- Files a new agent should read next:
